verdict.rationale: Auth Rules v2 can enforce authorization logic on MCC at the program, account, or card level during the card authorization stream, which covers MCC-based restriction at authorization time. Single-merchant locks are not documented as a native control. They could only be built through ASA's custom HTTP approval decisions, which means running your own endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit allowlist vs. blocklist rule semantics for MCC, a native single-merchant lock control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
